# Level packs (generated by `cargo xtask format-docs`; do not edit)

Files: `level.ron` ([LevelFile](#levelfile)), `live.ron` ([LiveFile](#livefile)), `editor/placed.ron` ([PlacedFile](#placedfile)), `material.png`, `front.png`, `back.png`, `thumb.png`, `look/glow.png`, `look/glow-back.png`, `look/groups.png`, `look/groups-back.png`, `look/clear.png`, `look/surface.png`, `look/surface-back.png`, `distant/<i>.png`, `distant/<i>-glow.png`, `live/<copy>/<k>.png`, `live/<copy>/<k>-rock.png`, `live/<copy>/<k>-glow.png`, `live/<copy>/<k>-groups.png`, `live/<copy>/<k>-beam.png`, `live/<copy>/<k>-glass.png`, `live/<k>.rhai`, `live/<k>.ogg`, [`editor/asset.ron`](asset.md), `editor/<key>/`, `editor/scripts/<id>.rhai`, `editor/level.rhai`.

The level authoring format: `level.ron`, `material.png`, `front.png`, `back.png` and an optional `thumb.png` (spec §6), and an optional placement under `editor/` that bakes into them (plan 14a's composition, issues #73 and #74). A level may have distant (parallax) layers (issue #11), `distant/<i>.png`: they show where `back.png` is see-through (alpha 0), scrolling slower than the level, and through its glass (alpha 1 to 254: the background glass design), whose tint and frost are `look/glass.png`; without them every back pixel is opaque, as always. A level whose look has surface materials (issue #37, `material.md`) may have `look/surface.png` and `look/surface-back.png`: what its front and back pixels are made of, for the look only.

Issues #73 and #74: a composed level is placed copies of assets, `editor/placed.ron` (OLR 0.2's `editor/composition.ron` is read only to convert it). Its ground (the level's own painted asset, key `ground`) is an asset folder rooted at `editor/` itself (`editor/asset.ron`, `editor/layers/<id>.png`, …, see `asset.md`); every other asset it uses is a copy in `editor/<key>/` (`a`, `b`, …); a copy's own script is `editor/scripts/<id>.rhai` and the level script `editor/level.rhai`. Static copies bake into the level's files in their starting state, stretched to their placed size (nearest neighbour), and their glow groups and materials are gathered into the level's look.

Issue #85: a Live copy is not baked into the level's files: saving writes it, at its placed size and split into parts, to the level's played form, `live.ron` and `live/` (outside `editor/`, so they are play files: hashed, downloaded and replayed with the level), and matches keep it an object. A level whose played form does not check does not load.

Issue #76: a level travels to be edited as one `.olrlevel` archive (`olr-cli level export`, `level import`): the pack whole, `editor/` and every asset copy and script included, in `.olpk`'s layout under its own magic `OLRL1\n` (an `.olpk`, the online download, carries only the baked, playable files). Imported, the level goes among the user's packs and its assets into the user's library: an identical one reused, a different one of a taken name added as "Console 2", none written over.

<a id="levelfile"></a>

## LevelFile (`level.ron`)

`level.ron`: what the level is, besides its images.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | required | Shown in menus. |
| `notes` | string | `""` | Free text for authors; ignored by the game. |
| `size` | (integer, integer) | required | Width and height in world pixels, each 1 to `MAX_SIDE` (4096); `material.png` is this size. |
| `art_scale` | integer | `1` | Art pixels per world pixel, 1 to `MAX_ART_SCALE` (8): `front.png` and `back.png` are `size` × `art_scale` (at most 64 Mi pixels). |
| `theme` | string | required | The id of the theme pack whose holes and green dirt the level uses. |
| `objects` | list of [LevelObject](#levelobject) | `[]` | Things placed in the level, at most `MAX_OBJECTS` (4096); an editor addresses them by index. |
| `look` | [LookSource](#looksource) (optional) | none | The level's look (darkness, light settings, grade, glow groups); none draws as OLX did. Default none. |
| `distant` | list of [DistantEntry](#distantentry) | `[]` | The level's distant (parallax) layers, far to near (the element order: each later one in front of the earlier ones), at most `MAX_DISTANT` (16); the `i`-th one's image is `distant/<i>.png`. They show where `back.png` is see-through (alpha 0). Default none. |

Example:

```ron
(
    name: "Twin Caves",
    notes: "Two caves joined by a tunnel.",
    size: (320, 200),
    theme: "olx-theme-dirt",
    objects: [
        Spawn(
            at: (40, 150),
        ),
        Spawn(
            at: (280, 150),
            notes: "the right cave",
        ),
    ],
)
```

<a id="livefile"></a>

## LiveFile (`live.ron`)

`live.ron`: a level's live copies as matches play them.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `copies` | list of [LiveCopyFile](#livecopyfile) | required | The live copies, bottom to top, at most `MAX_LIVE_COPIES` (64); the `i`-th one's pictures are in `live/<i>/`. |
| `scripts` | list of string | `[]` | The scripts, each `live/<k>.rhai` for its index `k` (UTF-8 Rhai, at most 64 KiB), at most `MAX_SCRIPTS` (129: the level's, and a default and an own per copy); identical texts are stored once. Default none. |
| `level_script` | integer (optional) | none | The level script: an index into `scripts`. Default none. |
| `sounds` | list of string | `[]` | The sounds, each `live/<k>.ogg` or `live/<k>.wav` for its index `k` (at most 2 MiB and 60 s, as a mod's), at most `MAX_LIVE_SOUNDS` (64); identical files are stored once. Default none. |

Example:

```ron
(
    copies: [
        (
            id: "lamp-2",
            asset: "Lamp",
            at: (200, 80),
            size: (8, 8),
            props: [
                (
                    name: "strength",
                    drives: GlowStrength(0),
                    min: 0,
                    max: 100,
                    default: 100,
                ),
                (
                    drives: GlowColour(0),
                    min: -1,
                    max: 16777215,
                    default: -1,
                ),
            ],
            pictures: [
                (
                    size: (8, 8),
                    glow: true,
                    groups: true,
                ),
                (
                    size: (8, 8),
                    glow: true,
                    groups: true,
                ),
            ],
            states: [
                (
                    name: "On",
                    values: [
                        (1, -1),
                    ],
                    parts: [
                        (
                            layer: 0,
                            kind: Background,
                            picture: 0,
                            glow_strength: 80,
                        ),
                    ],
                    enter_sound: 0,
                ),
                (
                    name: "Off",
                    values: [
                        (1, 3355443),
                    ],
                    parts: [
                        (
                            layer: 0,
                            kind: Background,
                            picture: 1,
                            glow_strength: 80,
                        ),
                    ],
                ),
            ],
            start_values: [
                (0, 60),
            ],
            animations: [
                Steady,
            ],
            groups: [
                (
                    id: "lamps",
                    intensity: 300,
                    reach: Pixels(60),
                ),
            ],
            scripts: [
                1,
                2,
            ],
            sounds: [
                ("tick.wav", 0),
            ],
        ),
    ],
    scripts: [
        "live/0.rhai",
        "live/1.rhai",
        "live/2.rhai",
    ],
    level_script: 0,
    sounds: [
        "live/0.wav",
    ],
)
```

<a id="placedfile"></a>

## PlacedFile (`editor/placed.ron`)

`editor/placed.ron`: the assets a level holds and the copies placed from them.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `assets` | list of [LevelAsset](#levelasset) | required | The assets the level holds a copy of, at most `MAX_LEVEL_ASSETS` (256), each named by at least one copy. |
| `copies` | list of [PlacedCopy](#placedcopy) | required | The placed copies, bottom to top, at most `MAX_COPIES` (1024). |
| `script` | boolean | `false` | The level has a level script, `editor/level.rhai` (UTF-8 Rhai, at most 64 KiB). Default false. |

Example:

```ron
(
    assets: [
        (
            key: "ground",
            origin: Own,
        ),
        (
            key: "a",
            origin: Builtin("strip-light"),
        ),
        (
            key: "b",
            origin: Yours("crane"),
        ),
        (
            key: "c",
            origin: Own,
        ),
    ],
    copies: [
        (
            id: "ground",
            asset: "ground",
            locked: true,
        ),
        (
            id: "lamp-1",
            asset: "a",
            at: (120, 80),
        ),
        (
            id: "lamp-2",
            asset: "a",
            at: (200, 80),
            size: (58, 4),
            free_aspect: true,
        ),
        (
            id: "crane",
            asset: "b",
            at: (400, 60),
            size: (64, 40),
            live: true,
            state: "Moving",
            values: {
                "claw_x": Int(20),
            },
            script: true,
            default_script: false,
        ),
        (
            id: "hills",
            asset: "c",
            at: (-200, 0),
            distant: 80,
        ),
    ],
    script: true,
)
```

<a id="levelobject"></a>

## LevelObject (enum)

A thing placed in a level.

| Variant | Fields | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Spawn` | `at`, `notes` | A spawn point (world pixels). The 0.2 runtime does not read spawns yet. |

### `LevelObject::Spawn`

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `at` | (integer, integer) | required | World pixels (x, y), origin top-left, y down; outside the level is a warning of `olr-cli pack check`. |
| `notes` | string | `""` | Free text for authors; ignored by the game. |

<a id="looksource"></a>

## LookSource

A level's look: darkness, light settings, grade and glow groups. A level without one draws as it always has.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ambient` | [AmbientSource](#ambientsource) | each field's default | Default: white at 100 (no darkness). |
| `occlusion` | [OcclusionSource](#occlusionsource) (optional) | none | Darkens the ambient light in air near rock and dirt (issue #10). Default none: no occlusion. |
| `max_light` | integer | `100` | The brightest light, percent, 100 to 200 (above 100, flashes brighten a lit level). Default 100. |
| `light_steps` | integer | `0` | Bands the light: 0 (off) or 2 to 32. Default 0. |
| `softness` | integer | `0` | Blurs the light, world pixels, 0 to 4. Default 0. |
| `light_soak` | integer | `8` | How deep light soaks into solids from the air beside them, world pixels, 0 to 12, fading with depth, unless the pixel's material sets its own (issue #57: `look.materials`' `light_soak`). Default 8. |
| `solid_floor` | [SolidFloorSource](#solidfloorsource) | each field's default | The least light of an opaque solid. Default white at 30. |
| `grade` | [GradeSource](#gradesource) | each field's default | Default none. |
| `glow_groups` | list of [GlowGroupSource](#glowgroupsource) | `[]` | At most 255. Default none. |
| `materials` | list of [MaterialSource](#materialsource) | `[]` | The surface materials its pixels are made of (presentation only, apart from the collision material): copies of the library's, by id, at most 255, ids unique. `look/surface.png` and `look/surface-back.png` name them by 1 + their index (0 is none). Default none. |
| `haze` | integer | `0` | Percent, 0 to 100: how much the level's air scatters its glow beams (the directional-glow design): at 50 the air and the sky in a beam glow with the beam's own light, at 100 twice it. `look/haze.png` scales it per pixel. Default 0. |

<a id="distantentry"></a>

## DistantEntry

A distant (parallax) layer (issue #11): its image `distant/<i>.png` is art pixels (the level's art scale; alpha 0 uncovered, anything else covered and drawn opaque), each side a multiple of `art_scale` and at most `MAX_SIDE` (4096) world pixels. It shows through the level's see-through back pixels, scrolling by `1 - depth` of the camera's movement, lit by `1 - depth` of the light beyond the ambient. Purely decoration: no collision material, never in the simulation.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `depth` | integer | required | Percent, 1 (near: moves and is lit almost like the level) to 99 (far: almost still, ambient light only). |
| `at` | (integer, integer) | required | Its top-left in world pixels with the camera (the view's centre) at the level's centre; with the camera at `c` it lies at `at + depth × (c - size / 2)`. Each coordinate within `MAX_DISTANT_AT` (16384) of 0. |
| `surface` | string (optional) | none | The whole layer's surface material (issue #37): the id of one of the look's `materials`. Default none. When it heats, explosions heat the layer as slices of a ball (issue #41): the layer lies `z = 14 + depth × 1.1` world pixels behind the worms' plane (the level's own back wall at 14, issue #65), and an explosion of heat radius `R` warms it in a circle of radius `sqrt(R² − z²)` behind it, less the further back (no heat at depth 46 and beyond, past the largest radius, 64). A hot layer glows but casts no light. |
| `glow` | integer | `0` | The layer's glow strength (issue #62): percent, 1 to 100, with `glow_group`; default none. Its light is baked into the level's `look/glow-back.png` and `look/groups-back.png` where it covers a see-through back pixel with the camera at the level's centre (its reference placement, `at`); its picture is lit by its own glow wherever it is drawn. A small bright feature (a lit window in a far city) lights the level as seen from the centre, so with the camera far from it its light and its drawn place part; a broad source (a sky, a sunset, moon glow) shows no difference. Its painted mask, when it has one, is `distant/<i>-glow.png` (grey, the image's size: 0 no glow to 255 full). |
| `glow_group` | string (optional) | none | The id of the layer's glow group in the look's `glow_groups` (issue #62), with `glow`. Default none. |

<a id="livecopyfile"></a>

## LiveCopyFile

A live copy: a placed copy that stays an object in the match.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | required | The copy's id (`editor/placed.ron`'s): scripts reach it by it. Unique among the live copies. |
| `asset` | string | required | The name of its asset, 1 to 64 characters, for messages. |
| `at` | (integer, integer) | required | Its top-left, world pixels; its box lies inside the level. |
| `size` | (integer, integer) | required | Its placed size, world pixels, each side 1 to 4096. |
| `props` | list of [LivePropFile](#livepropfile) | `[]` | Its values, at most `MAX_LIVE_PROPS` (96): every property the asset exposes or any state sets, and `Health` for a destructible asset. Default none. |
| `pictures` | list of [LivePictureFile](#livepicturefile) | required | Its pictures, at most `MAX_PICTURES` (128); the `k`-th one's files are `live/<copy>/<k>.png` and its optional masks. |
| `states` | list of [LiveStateFile](#livestatefile) | required | Its states, 1 to 32, in the asset's order. |
| `start_state` | integer | `0` | The index of its starting state. Default 0. |
| `start_values` | list of (integer, integer) | `[]` | The copy's own values (prop index, value), applied once after its starting state's: only properties the starting state does not set. Default none. |
| `animations` | list of [AnimationSource](#animationsource) | `[]` | The copy's animation table: every distinct animation its defaults, states and values name, in order of first appearance, at most `MAX_ANIMATIONS` (256); an `Animation` value is an index into it. Default none. |
| `groups` | list of [GlowGroupSource](#glowgroupsource) | `[]` | The asset's glow groups, the copy's own at run time (two copies change colour apart); a picture's groups name them 1-based. The level's groups and every copy's are at most 255 together. Default none. |
| `scripts` | list of integer | `[]` | The scripts run on the copy, in order (indices into the level's `scripts`): the asset's default unless the copy switched it off, then the copy's own. Default none. |
| `sounds` | list of (string, integer) | `[]` | The asset's sounds by name (each `[a-z0-9_-]` then `.wav` or `.ogg`, unique), each an index into the level's `sounds`. Default none. |
| `health` | [LiveHealthFile](#livehealthfile) (optional) | none | The copy can be destroyed. Default none. |

<a id="levelasset"></a>

## LevelAsset

An asset the level holds a copy of, in its own folder.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | required | Its folder in `editor/`, internal (scripts name copies, never keys): `ground` is the ground, stored in `editor/` itself (an `Own` asset); any other is `[a-z0-9-]`, 1 to 16 bytes, not starting with `-`, never one of the ground's folder names (`images`, `layers`, `masks`, `glow`, `surface`, `sounds`, `scripts`), stored in `editor/<key>/`. The editor gives `a`, `b`, … `z`, `aa`, `ab`, …, the first free, in the order the assets join the level. Unique. |
| `origin` | [AssetOrigin](#assetorigin) | required | Where the asset comes from. |

<a id="placedcopy"></a>

## PlacedCopy

A copy of an asset placed in the level.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | required | `[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*`, 1 to 32 bytes, unique among the copies: scripts reach the copy by it. |
| `asset` | string | required | The key of the asset it copies (one of `assets`). |
| `at` | (integer, integer) | `(0, 0)` | Its top-left, world pixels, each within 16384 (`4 × MAX_SIDE`) of 0. Default `(0, 0)`. |
| `size` | (integer, integer) (optional) | none | Its placed size, world pixels, each 1 to `MAX_SIDE` (4096): the asset stretched to it, nearest neighbour. Default none: the asset's size. |
| `free_aspect` | boolean | `false` | The copy panel's free resize (the aspect not kept); any `size` is taken either way. Default false. |
| `live` | boolean | `false` | Live: the copy stays an object in the match, driven by its states, values and scripts (for now it bakes as a static copy). Only an asset with more than one state, exposed values, sounds or a script, holding no dirt, raster or distant layer, and not placed distant. Default false: static, baked into the level in its starting state. |
| `state` | string (optional) | none | The name of its starting state, one of its asset's states. Default none: the asset's `start`. |
| `values` | map of name → [ValueSource](#valuesource) | `{}` | Its own values of the asset's exposed properties, by exposed name, each of the property's type within its `min` to `max`: the copy's defaults (a state's own value comes first). Default none. |
| `script` | boolean | `false` | The copy has its own script, `editor/scripts/<id>.rhai` (UTF-8 Rhai, at most 64 KiB). Default false. |
| `default_script` | boolean | `true` | The asset's default script runs on this copy too. Default true. |
| `distant` | integer (optional) | none | Placed as a distant (parallax) layer of this depth, 1 to 99: only an asset of Background images and plain drawn layers. Default none. |
| `locked` | boolean | `false` | The level tab and `olr-cli level copy` do not move, resize, set or remove it (the editor's only: no effect on the bake or play). Default false. |

<a id="ambientsource"></a>

## AmbientSource

The light everywhere, unblocked.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `colour` | [colour](#colour) (optional) | none | Opaque. Default none: white. |
| `intensity` | integer | `100` | Percent, 0 to 100. Default 100. |

<a id="occlusionsource"></a>

## OcclusionSource

Ambient occlusion (issue #10): air near opaque rock and dirt shows less of the ambient light, so tunnels, corners and pockets read as deep. Only the ambient light is darkened (not glow light or flashes) and only in air; the worm and solid floors still hold. Outside the level is open air.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `strength` | integer | required | How much of the ambient light is taken away from air right against a thick wall, percent, 1 to 100 (100: none of it is left there; leave the occlusion out for none). It weighs the rock and dirt within the reach: a corner, a pocket or a narrow tunnel loses as much further out, beside a thin wall less is taken. |
| `reach` | integer | `12` | How far from a solid the darkening fades out to nothing, world pixels, 2 to 32. Default 12. |

<a id="solidfloorsource"></a>

## SolidFloorSource

The least light an opaque solid pixel (rock or dirt that is not clear) shows, so deep rock still shows its art.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `colour` | [colour](#colour) (optional) | none | Opaque. Default none: white. |
| `intensity` | integer | `30` | Percent, 0 to 100 (0: none). Default 30 (plan 15a Stop 1b). |

<a id="gradesource"></a>

## GradeSource

A level's colour grade, applied to the lit world (not the HUD).

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `exposure` | integer | `0` | Hundredths of a stop, -200 to 200. Default 0. |
| `contrast` | integer | `100` | Percent, 0 to 200. Default 100. |
| `saturation` | integer | `100` | Percent, 0 to 200. Default 100. |
| `tint` | [colour](#colour) (optional) | none | Multiplied in; opaque. Default none: white. |

<a id="glowgroupsource"></a>

## GlowGroupSource

A group of glowing pixels: how they light the world and animate. The pixels name it in `look/groups.png` by 1 + its index (0 is no group).

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | required | A slug unique in the level (`[a-z0-9_.-]`); the editor's elements name it. |
| `colour` | [GlowColourSource](#glowcoloursource) | `Own` | Default `Own`. |
| `intensity` | integer | `100` | The glowing surface's brightness, percent, 0 to 1000. Default 100. |
| `reach` | [ReachSource](#reachsource) | required | How far its light reaches; `Unlimited` lights the whole level (a sun). |
| `animation` | [AnimationSource](#animationsource) | `Steady` | Default `Steady`. |
| `phase_ms` | integer (optional) | none | Default none: from the group's id. |

<a id="materialsource"></a>

## MaterialSource

A surface material: a file `<id>.ron` of a material library, or one of a level's `look.materials`.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | required | 1 to 64 bytes of `[a-z0-9_-]`, starting with a letter or digit; unique in a level, and a library file's name (`<id>.ron`). A level's elements name it. |
| `name` | string | required | Shown in the editors, 1 to 64 characters. |
| `notes` | string | `""` | Free text for authors; ignored by the game. |
| `light_soak` | integer (optional) | none | How deep light soaks into its rock and dirt from the air beside them, world pixels, 0 to 12 (issue #57): thin for concrete and stone, deeper for furniture. Default none: the level's `look.light_soak`. |
| `heat` | [HeatSource](#heatsource) (optional) | none | How it takes heat, spreads it, loses it and shows it. Default none: it never heats. |

<a id="livepropfile"></a>

## LivePropFile

One value of a live copy.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string (optional) | none | Its exposed name (`[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*`, 1 to 32 bytes, unique in the copy); none for a property only states set, which scripts cannot reach. Default none. |
| `drives` | [Target](#target) | required | What it drives. |
| `min` | integer | required | Its least value (world pixels for a position). |
| `max` | integer | required | Its greatest value, at least `min`. |
| `default` | integer | required | Its value where no state and no copy sets it, `min` to `max`. |

<a id="livepicturefile"></a>

## LivePictureFile

One of a live copy's pictures: `live/<copy>/<k>.png` (RGBA, its size × the level's art scale) and the masks it has.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `size` | (integer, integer) | required | World pixels, each side 1 to the copy's. |
| `rock` | boolean | `false` | `<k>-rock.png`: its solid mask, grey per world pixel (0 open, any other value solid). A rock part's picture has it, a background part's not. Default false. |
| `glow` | boolean | `false` | `<k>-glow.png`: its unscaled glow mask, grey per art pixel (the shown glow is mask × the part's strength, as the level's glow). Default false. |
| `groups` | boolean | `false` | `<k>-groups.png`: the copy's own glow group per world pixel, grey, 1-based into the copy's `groups` (0 none). Default false. |
| `beam` | boolean | `false` | `<k>-beam.png`: direction and spread per world pixel, grey-alpha, as `look/glow-beam.png`. Default false. |
| `glass` | boolean | `false` | `<k>-glass.png`: its glass, RGBA per art pixel, as `look/glass.png`. Default false. |

<a id="livestatefile"></a>

## LiveStateFile

A state of a live copy: a complete look.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | required | The asset's state name (unique in the copy, case aside); scripts name the state by it. |
| `values` | list of (integer, integer) | `[]` | (prop index, value) for every property any state of the asset sets: this state's value, else the property's default. Entering the state sets them all. Default none. |
| `parts` | list of [LivePartFile](#livepartfile) | required | Its parts, bottom to top, at most `MAX_PARTS` (32). |
| `enter_sound` | integer (optional) | none | An index into the level's `sounds`, played once when the state is entered. Default none. |
| `loop_sound` | integer (optional) | none | An index into the level's `sounds`, looped while the state lasts. Default none. |

<a id="animationsource"></a>

## AnimationSource (enum)

How a light's intensity changes over time. Levels are percent of its intensity (0 to 1000), times milliseconds. The clock is the match's (a mod's light: the projectile's age, or the time since its flash began).

| Variant | Fields | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Steady` | — | Constant. |
| `Pulse` | `period_ms`, `low`, `high`, `shape` | Between `low` and `high` over `period_ms` (1 to 600 000), starting at the midpoint and rising. |
| `Flicker` | `speed`, `depth` | A flame's unsteadiness: smooth noise, the same on every machine. |
| `Keys` | `keys`, `looped` | A hand-made curve, linear between keys. |

### `AnimationSource::Pulse`

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `period_ms` | integer | required | Milliseconds, 1 to 600 000. |
| `low` | integer | required | Percent, 0 to 1000. |
| `high` | integer | required | Percent, 0 to 1000. |
| `shape` | [PulseShape](#pulseshape) | `Sine` | The wave. Default `Sine`. |

### `AnimationSource::Flicker`

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `speed` | integer | required | Changes a second, 1 to 1000. |
| `depth` | integer | required | How far it dims, percent, 0 to 100. |

### `AnimationSource::Keys`

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `keys` | list of [keysource](#keysource) | required | 1 to 64 keys, their times not decreasing. |
| `looped` | boolean | `false` | Repeats after the last key; otherwise the light ends there (a flash). Default false. |

<a id="livehealthfile"></a>

## LiveHealthFile

A destructible live copy's health.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `points` | integer | required | 1 to 10000. |
| `at_zero` | integer | required | The index of the state entered at 0. |

<a id="assetorigin"></a>

## AssetOrigin (enum)

Where a level's asset comes from (ordered so a map can key on it, issue #76's `Libraries`).

| Variant | Fields | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Own` | — | The level's own, in no library (the ground). |
| `Builtin` | string | A copy of the built-in library's `content/assets/<folder>`; the folder is an asset id (`[a-z0-9_-]`, 1 to 64 bytes, not starting with `-` or `_`). |
| `Yours` | string | A copy of the user's library's `<data>/assets/<folder>`; the folder is an asset id. |

<a id="valuesource"></a>

## ValueSource (enum)

A property's value.

| Variant | Fields | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Int` | integer | A whole number. |
| `Bool` | boolean | Yes or no. |
| `Colour` | [colour](#colour) | An opaque colour, `Colour("#ff2020")`. |
| `Animation` | [AnimationSource](#animationsource) | A glow group's animation. |

<a id="colour"></a>

## colour

A colour in an authoring file: `"#rrggbb"` (opaque) or `"#rrggbbaa"` (alpha 00 transparent to ff opaque), hex digits read in any case. Written lowercase, without the alpha when opaque.

<a id="glowcoloursource"></a>

## GlowColourSource (enum)

What colour a glow group's pixels cast (their own glow always shows their art).

| Variant | Fields | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Own` | — | Each pixel's art colour. |
| `Tint` | [colour](#colour) | One colour; opaque. |
| `Filtered` | [colour](#colour) | One colour (opaque) filtered by each pixel's art colour, scaled so its brightest channel is full: a stained window casts its light in each pane's colour (the background glass design). |

<a id="reachsource"></a>

## ReachSource (enum)

How far a light reaches: it fades to nothing there.

| Variant | Fields | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Pixels` | integer | World pixels, 1 to 4096. |
| `Unlimited` | — | No fade (in a level, glow light reaches across the whole level). |

<a id="heatsource"></a>

## HeatSource

A material's heat. Explosions deposit heat; it spreads between neighbouring pixels, soaks in and cools to the air, by these values. Each is percent of the engine's reference material, stone (100).

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sensitivity` | integer | `100` | How much of the deposited heat a pixel takes, percent, 0 to 100 (0: it never heats, as without `heat`). Default 100. |
| `capacity` | integer | required | How much heat it takes to warm a pixel, percent of stone's, 10 to 1000: higher warms less from the same blast and holds its heat longer. |
| `conductivity` | integer | required | How fast heat spreads to neighbouring pixels of materials that conduct, and so how deep it soaks in, percent of stone's, 0 (none) to 1000. |
| `cooling` | integer | required | How fast a pixel beside air loses its heat to it, percent of stone's, 1 to 1000. |
| `look` | [HeatLookSource](#heatlooksource) | each field's default | How it looks hot. Default: the engine's ramp, every glow cast as light. |

<a id="target"></a>

## Target (enum)

What a live copy's value drives: the asset's `PropertySource` with its layer mapped to the copy's parts of that layer (`LivePartFile::layer`, the layer's index in the asset, bottom first). Values: an `Int` as it is (positions in world pixels, scaled with the copy's stretch), a `Bool` 0 or 1, a `Colour` `0xRRGGBB` (`-1`: the glow group's own, each pixel's colour), an `Animation` an index into the copy's animation table.

| Variant | Fields | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `X` | — | The copy's offset from where it is placed, world pixels. |
| `Y` | — | As `X`, down. |
| `Visible` | — | 0 or 1: the copy is drawn and solid. |
| `Facing` | — | 0 or 1: 1 mirrors the copy left to right within its box. |
| `Health` | — | 0 to the copy's health points. |
| `OffsetX` | integer | A layer's offset inside the copy, world pixels. |
| `OffsetY` | integer | As `OffsetX`, down. |
| `LayerVisible` | integer | 0 or 1: a layer shown (hidden rock is not solid). |
| `Opacity` | integer | Percent 0 to 100: a background layer's opacity. |
| `GlowStrength` | integer | Percent 0 to 100: a layer's glow strength (each pixel mask × value). |
| `GlowColour` | integer | `0xRRGGBB` (or -1, its own): the layer's glow group's colour. |
| `LightIntensity` | integer | Percent 0 to 1000: the layer's glow group's intensity. |
| `LightReach` | integer | World pixels 1 to 4096: the layer's glow group's reach. |
| `GlowAnimation` | integer | An index into the animation table: the layer's glow group's animation. |
| `BeamDirection` | integer | Degrees 0 to 359: the layer's beam's direction. |
| `BeamSpread` | integer | Degrees 1 to 90: the layer's beam's half-angle. |
| `GlassOpacity` | integer | Percent 1 to 99: a glass layer's opacity. |
| `GlassTint` | integer | Percent 0 to 100: a glass layer's tint. |

<a id="livepartfile"></a>

## LivePartFile

One part of a live copy in a state.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `layer` | integer (optional) | none | The asset layer it shows (its index, bottom first), which values target; none for untargeted layers flattened together. A targeted mixed layer's background and rock parts share it. Default none. |
| `kind` | [PartKind](#partkind) | required | Rock or background. |
| `picture` | integer | required | An index into the copy's `pictures`: a rock part's picture has a rock mask, a background part's none. |
| `at` | (integer, integer) | `(0, 0)` | Its picture's top-left in the copy, world pixels; the picture lies inside the copy. Default `(0, 0)`. |
| `glow_strength` | integer | `0` | Percent 0 to 100: its glow strength as authored (shown: mask × strength). Default 0. |

<a id="pulseshape"></a>

## PulseShape (enum)

The wave of a `Pulse`.

| Variant | Fields | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Sine` | — | Smooth. |
| `Triangle` | — | Linear up and down. |
| `Square` | — | `high` for the first half of the period, `low` for the second. |

<a id="keysource"></a>

## keysource

One key of a `Keys` animation, written `(at_ms, level)` or `(at_ms, level, "#rrggbb")`: milliseconds from the curve's start, the intensity in percent (0 to 1000), and the light's colour from this key on.

<a id="heatlooksource"></a>

## HeatLookSource

How a hot material looks.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ramp` | list of [RampKeySource](#rampkeysource) | `[]` | Temperature to colour and glow: 1 to 16 keys, their temperatures rising. Below the first key a pixel shows its art; between keys the colour and glow are linear; above the last, the last. Default none: the engine's lava ramp (a faint dull red from 100, orange from about 450, yellow-white at 1000). |
| `light` | integer | `100` | Percent of its glow cast as light into the level, 0 (it shows hot but lights nothing) to 100. Default 100. |

<a id="partkind"></a>

## PartKind (enum)

What a part is.

| Variant | Fields | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Rock` | — | Solid, drawn as front art; never dug. |
| `Background` | — | Scenery, drawn as back art. |

<a id="rampkeysource"></a>

## RampKeySource

One key of a colour ramp.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `temperature` | integer | required | The engine's temperature scale, 1 to 1000. |
| `colour` | [colour](#colour) | required | What a pixel this hot shows over its art; opaque. |
| `glow` | integer | required | How strongly the colour shows over the art and glows whatever the darkness, percent, 0 to 100. |
